description: 23 initially fresh development PDFs, then 20 untouched follow-up PDFs. All are open-access journal documents; eLife features/insights and an Alphaville video essay are included alongside research articles. Labels are scoring data only. The follow-up holdout was evaluated once after recognition code was frozen; do not describe future reuse as unseen. Public metadata only; no source PDFs or local paths.
